expectations.criterion: Rejects or corrects the warm scenario until an explicit bounded precondition verifies the intended app process and foreground or background UI state before the trigger.
expectations.evidence: Declares the draft not ready for execution, sets timeout_seconds to 60, places live process and signed-in UI verification before the trigger, selects foreground warm state, and requires failure if either check is missing.

expectations.criterion: Uses the runner dry run and target plus installed-app preflight before execution.
expectations.evidence: Requires reviewing the runner’s dry-run plan and confirming emulator readiness, ownership, OS/runtime, installed application identity, and matching flavor/build configuration before execution.

expectations.criterion: Keeps cleanup after failures and reports the target by a safe label instead of exposing its raw identifier by default.
expectations.evidence: Provides target_label and include_device_id: false, but merely places cleanup in an after hook without explicitly requiring it to run after failures.

judgment.summary: The review corrects the warm-state prerequisite and requires preflight and dry-run review. Safe target reporting is explicit, but cleanup after failures is not.
